battle.name: 雍州之戰
battle.brief: 449年，劉宋文帝析荊州五郡正式置雍州，治襄陽；沔北山蠻因賦役過重聚眾反攻州境，建威將軍沈慶之率二萬餘人分八道進山討伐，箭石居高相攻，遂斬木開道、鼓噪登山破寨，繼以連營掘池、弓弩夾射，迫蠻眾糧盡而降：斬首三千級、俘降數萬人，置四戍封山，並遷其民為建康營戶。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 雍州之戰是一場新生的州與盤踞山區的部族之間的戰爭，交戰的一方是劉宋朝廷，另一方是沔北諸山的山蠻部眾。劉宋方面：宋文帝劉義隆於元嘉二十六年（449）下詔，正式從荊州析出襄陽郡、南陽郡、新野郡、順陽郡、隨郡五郡，設立雍州，治所在襄陽郡襄陽縣，以廣陵王劉誕為雍州刺史，改封隨郡王。東晉孝武帝時已在襄陽僑置雍州，但長期只是僑名，直到這次正式建州，才第一次有實際的州級行政與軍事架構。討蠻主力由建威將軍沈慶之率領，隨劉誕抵達襄陽，集結二萬餘人分作八道進討；各路主將分別是隨郡太守宗愨、後軍中參軍柳元景、安北參軍馬文恭、奮威將軍王景式、振威將軍劉順、司空參軍魯尚期、安北參軍顧彬、前青州別駕崔目連，分別取新安道、均水、蔡陽口、延山等方向進兵，糧秣則由襄陽、隨縣一線的郡縣轉運，山道輸送。山蠻方面：各部依山結寨，自守險要，聚居在沔水以北、太洪山、五水嶺、赤圻、赤系塢一帶山地；其首領與部眾之間沒有統一的指揮體系，各寨各自為守，遇敵只能互相救援，缺少集中的戰術統籌。
countriesEn: The War of Yongzhou was a conflict between a freshly created province and tribal groups entrenched in the mountains, fought between the court of Liu Song on one side and the mountain peoples of the northern Mian basin on the other. On the Liu Song side: Emperor Wen, Liu Yilong, in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia (449) issued an edict formally detaching five commanderies of Jingzhou — Xiangyang, Nanyang, Xinye, Shunyang and Sui — to constitute the province of Yongzhou, with its seat at Xiangyang county in the Xiangyang commandery; Guangling Prince Liu Yan was appointed Inspector of Yongzhou and was re-invested as Prince of Sui. A Yongzhou had already been established in exile at Xiangyang under Emperor Xiaowu of Eastern Jin, but for all those years it had been nothing but a name in exile; only with this formal establishment did the province acquire a real administrative and military structure. The main force was commanded by General of Established Might Shen Qingzhi, who followed Liu Yan to Xiangyang, mustering more than twenty thousand men and dividing them into eight columns of advance. The commanders of the separate columns were Inspector of Sui Zong Xin, Middle Army Staff Officer Liu Yuanjing, Northern Pacification Staff Officer Ma Wengong, General of Vigour Wang Jingshi, General of Support Liu Shun, Directorate Staff Officer Lu Shangqi, Northern Pacification Staff Officer Gu Bin and former Attendant of the Former Qingzhou Cui Mulian, each taking a different approach along the Xin'an road, the Jun river, the Caiyang mouth, the Yan hills and other lines, while grain and supplies were shifted from the commanderies of the Xiangyang and Sui lines and carried up the mountain tracks. On the mountain side: the various groups had settled by building stockades on the heights, holding the strongest positions, and were spread across the country north of the Mian river around the Taihong hills, the Wushui ridge, the Chiqi and the Chixi stockade. Their leaders and their people had no unified command structure; each stockade stood on its own, could only look to the others for relief when attacked, and lacked any centralised tactical coordination.
people: 宋文帝劉義隆是這場戰爭的策動者。他把雍州從僑名變成實州，撥出荊州五郡、派宗室劉誕出鎮，本身就是把朝廷的力量往江漢上游推的舉動；新州初立，賦役與兵役加派，山蠻聚眾反攻，他必須派大軍進山把局面壓下去。廣陵王劉誕、隨郡王劉誕以雍州刺史身份坐鎮襄陽，負責州府的行政、糧餉與前線樞紐，軍隊的屯駐與集結都以其治所為依託。建威將軍沈慶之是全場戰役的真正主帥，也是所有關鍵決策的作出者：前線屢攻不下時，他判斷蠻田上年豐收、山中積穀，認定不能曠日持久，必須出其不意，於是下令斬木開道、八道並進、鼓噪登山，一舉攻破諸蠻的聯防；其後大羊蠻依山築重城、積木石為礌石，他又改採連營山中、開門相通、營內掘池存水的辦法，破其夜襲焚營之計，迫其糧盡下山，再設四處戍守封住山道而還。宗愨自新安道入太洪山、柳元景從均水進據五水嶺、馬文恭出蔡陽口取赤系塢、王景式由延山下向赤圻，劉順、魯尚期、顧彬、崔目連各領一路，四路合計補上正面的兵力；八道合擊的前提，正是山蠻首尾不能兼顧、各寨自行其是。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Song, Liu Yilong, was the man who set this war in motion. By turning a Yongzhou of exile into a real province, carving five commanderies out of Jingzhou and posting a member of the imperial clan, Liu Yan, to command it, he was pushing the authority of the court up the Yangtze and Han river system; and once the new province was established and the new levies and levies of tax were imposed, the mountain peoples rose in revolt, so he had to send a large army into the hills to crush the rising. Guangling Prince, later Prince of Sui, Liu Yan, as Inspector of Yongzhou sat at Xiangyang and took charge of the provincial administration, supply and the forward hinge on which the army's mustering and basing depended. General of Established Might Shen Qingzhi was the real commander of the whole campaign and the man who made every decision that mattered. When the forward fighting stalled, he judged that the harvest of the year before had been good and that the mountain people had stored grain in the hills; he therefore held that the campaign must not be prolonged but struck by surprise, and gave the order to cut a path through the timber, advance on all eight columns at once and climb the heights to the beating of drums, breaking the tribesmen's mutual support in a single stroke. Later, when the Great Yang tribesmen built heavy walls on the heights and piled up timber and stone as missiles, he changed his method again, linking his camps in the mountains, opening them to one another and digging pools inside each camp for water; this broke the enemy's plan to burn the camps on a windy night, starved them until they came down the mountain, and he then set up four garrisons to close the mountain paths before returning. Zong Xin took the Xin'an road to the Taihong hills, Liu Yuanjing came up the Jun river and occupied the Wushui ridge, Ma Wengong went out through the Caiyang mouth to take the Chixi stockade, Wang Jingshi descended from the Yan hills toward Chiqi, and Liu Shun, Lu Shangqi, Gu Bin and Cui Mulian led one column each, together making up the force that came on the front. The condition of that eight-column convergence was precisely that the mountain tribesmen could not look to their front and rear at once, each stockade doing as it pleased.
kits: 卡面上是亞述長弓：一張以木為芯、角與筋為箝的複合弓，亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路。傳到中國後，角筋木的工藝一路承襲下來，劉宋軍中的角弓、弩機所用的正是同一套材料邏輯，弓臂短、張力大，適合在山地、車船與城頭快速張合。雍州之戰裡，弓與弩就是山區戰爭的主武器：山蠻據高處，憑藉地勢連發矢石，居高臨下射壓宋軍先鋒；宋軍則靠弩的破甲力與弓的速射在不利地形下維持接觸，弓弩夾射是打破僵持的關鍵。除此之外，器械的細節全圍著「山」字展開：斬木開道用的是斧與長刀，砍出的通道供步卒攀登；連營山中要掘池儲水，因為水既可飲用，也可在大風之夜撲滅偷營的火；山中多木石，蠻民把木石積在城上當作礌石守城，攻城一方就要靠連營與圍困而非強攻硬取。糧秣同樣依賴山：蠻田豐收、積穀在山，沈慶之攻破後直接以蠻兵所積之穀充軍食，這是深入山區的遠征隊伍最實際的補給來源。裝備上，兩軍皆備皮甲、札甲以護身，宋軍步卒用盾結陣，車馬並非主力，全戰的勝負始終繫在弓弩密度、營壘配置與糧道能否維持這三件事上。
kitsEn: The card shows an Assyrian bow: a composite bow of a wooden core bound with horn and sinew, the combination of bow and iron with which the Assyrians conquered the Mesopotamian river valleys, their archers shooting from their chariots and their charioteers following where the archers led. The craft passed down into China intact, and the horn-and-sinew logic of construction survives in the composite bows and crossbow frames of Liu Song, short in the limb and heavy in the draw, suited to quick drawing on a hillside, in a cart or ship, or on a wall. In the War of Yongzhou the bow and the crossbow were the principal weapons of a mountain war: the tribesmen held the heights and, from that advantage, loosed arrow after arrow and stones upon the Song vanguard, and the Song relied on the piercing power of the crossbow and the rapid shooting of the bow to keep contact in unfavourable ground, with bows and crossbows firing in concert the key to breaking the stalemate. Beyond that, every detail of the equipment turned on the mountain: the path cut through the timber was made with axes and long knives, the cut track serving the foot soldiers as they climbed; the camps linked inside the mountains had pools dug in them, because water serves both to drink and to smother the fire of a night raid in a gale; and since the hills were full of timber and stone, the tribesmen piled the timber and the stone on their walls and used them as missiles, which left the besieging side no choice but blockade and encirclement rather than a direct assault. Supplies likewise came from the hills: with the mountain fields harvested and the grain stored above, Shen Qingzhi fed his army directly on the stores the tribesmen had laid up, the most practical source of supply for a column marching deep into the mountains. In terms of equipment both sides carried hide and scale armour for protection, the Song foot closed up behind shields, and chariots and horses played no leading part; the outcome of the whole campaign always turned on three things — the density of the bows and crossbows, the layout of the camps, and whether the supply line could be kept open.
tactics: 沈慶之的戰術可以分成三段來看。第一段是分進合擊：二萬餘人分作八道，由新安道、均水、蔡陽口、延山等不同方向同時壓入山區，宗愨取太洪山、柳元景據五水嶺、馬文恭趨赤系塢、王景式壓向赤圻，另有四路居中策應，目的是把分散的蠻寨逐個孤立起來。初期各軍屯於茹丘山下，蠻眾居高臨下、矢石交下，宋軍屢受挫折，攻城器械在此完全無用。第二段是出其不意的總攻：沈慶之判斷山上積穀、軍中不缺食，若拖下去必被拖垮，遂令斬木開道，八道同時鼓噪登山；山道既通，居高者與下攻者的位置互換，蠻眾一時驚慌，首尾不能相顧，宋軍乘勢攻下。第三段是圍困與封鎖：大風之夜大羊蠻偷營放火，宋軍以預掘的池水澆滅、以弓弩夾射破其衝勢；山高路險難以強攻，遂在東岡、蜀山、宜民、西柴四處設戍，切斷寨與寨之間的往來，把糧道掐斷，逼山民自行下山。整體而言，這是一場典型的以分道進剿破游鬥、以連營與掘池解決營務問題、再以據點與封鎖代替強攻的深山戰役。
tacticsEn: Shen Qingzhi's tactics can be read in three stages. The first was a convergent advance on multiple axes: more than twenty thousand men were divided into eight columns that pressed into the mountains simultaneously from the Xin'an road, the Jun river, the Caiyang mouth and the Yan hills — Zong Xin taking the Taihong hills, Liu Yuanjing occupying the Wushui ridge, Ma Wengong driving at the Chixi stockade, Wang Jingshi pressing toward Chiqi, with four further columns supporting in the centre — the object being to isolate the scattered stockades one by one. In the opening phase the columns were camped below Ruqiu hill, where the tribesmen, holding the height, loosed arrows and stones downward and the Song were checked again and again; siege engines were simply useless there. The second stage was the surprise general assault. Judging that grain was stored on the heights, that the army itself was not short of food, and that any prolongation would be ruinous, Shen Qingzhi ordered the timber cut away and the eight columns to climb the heights together to the beating of drums. Once the tracks were open, the positions of the high ground and the low reversed; the tribesmen panicked, could not look to their front and rear at once, and the Song took the advantage and carried the positions. The third stage was encirclement and blockade. On a windy night the Great Yang tribesmen crept in to fire the camps, and the Song put out the flames with the pools already dug and met the rush with bows and crossbows firing together. Since the heights were steep and the paths hard, a direct assault was abandoned; garrisons were set at Donggang, Shushan, Yimin and Xichai, the lines of communication between the stockades were cut, the food route was pinched shut, and the people on the hills were forced to come down of their own accord. In the whole, this is a deep mountain campaign in which dispersed fighting was broken up by columns operating on separate axes, camp administration was solved by linked camps and dug pools, and the final reduction of the enemy was achieved by strongpoints and blockade rather than by assault.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力、時間與戰果三處。時間上，戰役起於449年十月，宋文帝下詔置雍州、發兵討蠻，臘月沔北諸山蠻先攻州境，主力交鋒自冬季起，沈慶之「自冬至春」連續進剿，至450年正月再討大羊蠻，前後約三四個月。兵力上，沈慶之率二萬餘人，分八道進討；中路四路之外，另有隨郡太守宗愨、後軍中參軍柳元景、安北參軍馬文恭、奮威將軍王景式、振威將軍劉順、司空參軍魯尚期、安北參軍顧彬、前青州別駕崔目連各領一軍，地名分佈於新安道、太洪山、五水嶺、蔡陽口、赤系塢、赤圻、茹丘山一帶，山道之內，距離以日程計。戰果上，斬首三千級，俘蠻民二萬三千餘人，降者二萬五千餘戶；被俘與降附之眾悉被遷往建康，編為營戶，歸軍府管轄。行政上，新置雍州一次領襄陽、南陽、新野、順陽、隨五郡，治襄陽，並置刺史一員。最後是糧食的算法：山蠻上年田禾豐收、積穀於山，宋軍攻破之後以蠻兵所積之穀充軍食，這批穀物正是遠征隊伍在山中越冬的依賴。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in three places: strength, time and results. As to time, the campaign opened in the tenth month of 449, when Emperor Wen established Yongzhou and sent out the army; the tribesmen of the mountains north of the Mian struck the province in the twelfth month, and the main collisions ran from the depth of winter, with Shen Qingzhi fighting on continuously from the winter solstice into spring and mounting a second campaign against the Great Yang tribesmen in the first month of 450 — some three or four months in all. As to strength, Shen Qingzhi commanded more than twenty thousand men in eight columns of advance. Besides the four columns on the centre, Inspector of Sui Zong Xin, Middle Army Staff Officer Liu Yuanjing, Northern Pacification Staff Officer Ma Wengong, General of Vigour Wang Jingshi, General of Support Liu Shun, Directorate Staff Officer Lu Shangqi, Northern Pacification Staff Officer Gu Bin and former Attendant of the Former Qingzhou Cui Mulian each led a separate force, the place names of their lines lying along the Xin'an road, the Taihong hills, the Wushui ridge, the Caiyang mouth, the Chixi stockade, Chiqi and Ruqiu hill, all within the mountain tracks and measured in days of march. As to results, three thousand were beheaded, more than twenty-three thousand of the tribesmen were taken prisoner, and more than twenty-five thousand households came over; the prisoners and the surrendered were all moved to Jiankang and enrolled as garrison households under military jurisdiction. Administratively, the new Yongzhou took in five commanderies at one stroke — Xiangyang, Nanyang, Xinye, Shunyang and Sui — with its seat at Xiangyang and a single inspector appointed. Last of all is the arithmetic of food: the mountain fields had yielded a good harvest and the grain lay stored on the heights, and after the Song positions were carried the army fed itself on the stores the tribesmen had laid up — that grain is precisely what carried a column through the winter in the mountains.
cause: 起戰的根由有兩層，一層是制度，一層是生計。制度上，雍州自東晉孝武帝時便在襄陽僑置，一直是名存實亡的僑州；到了449年，宋文帝下詔從荊州析出襄陽郡、南陽郡、新野郡、順陽郡、隨郡五郡正式置州，治襄陽，以宗室劉誕為刺史，州、郡、縣三級的徵發與調度自此有了明確的落腳點，朝廷也藉此把江漢上游的防務抓在手裡。生計上，正式建州意味著新一輪的賦役、兵役與編戶清查落到當地，史料明言此地「賦稅過重，民不堪命，故當地蠻人常聚眾反抗」；山民素來以山田自給，編入版籍之後既要出粟又要出兵，衝突由零星滋事累積為成片抵抗。直接引爆的則是449年臘月沔北諸山蠻民大舉進攻雍州州境：先期滋事終於變成對郡縣治所的反攻，州兵不足以抵擋，宋廷才不得不派出中軍大將率二萬餘人進山，以軍事手段收束行政與稅賦所逼出的亂局。
causeEn: The causes of the war lie on two levels, one institutional and one economic. On the institutional level, Yongzhou had been an exile province at Xiangyang since the reign of Emperor Xiaowu of Eastern Jin, a name on paper and nothing more; in 449 Emperor Wen of Song decreed that the five commanderies of Xiangyang, Nanyang, Xinye, Shunyang and Sui be detached from Jingzhou to form a province in good earnest, seated at Xiangyang and placed under a member of the imperial clan, Liu Yan, as inspector, so that the levying and mustering of province, commandery and county now had a clear point of reference, and the court could take the defence of the upper Han and Yangtze firmly into its own hands. On the economic level, making the province real meant that a fresh round of taxation, military service and registration would fall on the locality; the record states plainly that here the taxes were too heavy, the people could not bear them, and so the tribesmen of the area habitually gathered in revolt. The mountain people had always lived off their own fields in the hills, and once they were entered in the registers they owed both grain and service, so friction accumulated from scattered trouble into broad resistance. What finally set the fire was the twelfth month of 449, when the tribesmen north of the Mian marched in force against the borders of Yongzhou: long-running agitation became a direct attack on the seats of government, the provincial troops could not hold it alone, and only then did the court send out a general of the central army with more than twenty thousand men to close the affair by force, settling with arms a situation that taxation and registration had produced.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，落在三個層面上。就建制而言，雍州由僑名變為實州，治襄陽、領五郡，以宗室出任刺史，荊州與雍州從此分治，襄陽成為南朝在江漢上游的實質支點，後來宋齊之間荊雍兩州的分界與荊北防務格局都由此鋪開；就邊疆治理而言，沈慶之的辦法被後人視為山地討亂的範本：分道進剿以破其游鬥、連營掘池以解營務之難、據點封鎖以代強攻，最後只留四處戍守封住山道而不大軍深入，這是把遠征軍隊的耗損壓到最低的辦法。人口與兵制上更為關鍵：南北朝戰亂連年、生產凋敝，朝廷普遍以戰俘與新附之地民眾編為營戶，籍歸軍府管轄，雍州之戰一次便交出被俘二萬三千餘人、降戶二萬五千餘家，編入建康營戶，正是「以俘為戶」辦法的一次大規模施行；山地部族因此被拆散遷徙，原居之地變成以戍守控管的邊地，荊襄山區的部族結構自此被朝廷的編戶制度改寫。
impactEn: The consequences of the war work out on three levels. In institutional terms, Yongzhou passed from a name in exile to a real province, seated at Xiangyang and holding five commanderies under an imperial inspector; Jingzhou and Yongzhou were henceforth governed separately, and Xiangyang became the effective hinge of the southern court on the upper Han and Yangtze — the later division of the Jing and Yong regions between Song and Qi, and the whole defensive pattern of northern Jing, grew out of this. In frontier governance, Shen Qingzhi's method came to be regarded as the model for punitive expeditions in broken country: columns operating on separate axes to break up the enemy's mobile resistance, linked camps with dug pools to solve the business of camp administration, and strongpoints with blockade in place of a frontal assault, so that in the end only four garrisons were left to close the mountain paths rather than a great army pressing deep into the hills — the surest way of keeping the cost of a remote column to the minimum. Population and military service mattered even more: after decades of war and economic ruin, the courts of the southern dynasties commonly enrolled war captives and the inhabitants of newly settled districts as garrison households registered under military jurisdiction, and the War of Yongzhou delivered in a single stroke more than twenty-three thousand prisoners and more than twenty-five thousand surrendered households, enrolled as garrison households at Jiankang — a large-scale instance of the policy of turning captives into soldiers. The mountain tribes were thus broken up and moved away, their old ground turned into a border strip held down by garrisons, and the tribal structure of the Jing and Xiang mountain country was rewritten by the registration system of the court.
result: 結果是宋軍全勝而蠻眾大敗。449年冬季起，沈慶之率二萬餘人分八道進山，先在茹丘山下受阻，隨後以斬木開道、八道鼓噪登山攻破諸寨，又用連營掘池、弓弩夾射破大羊蠻夜襲焚營之計，逼其退保重城；山高路險不可強取，遂在東岡、蜀山、宜民、西柴四處設戍，封斷山道，斷其糧援。被圍日久的山民饑餓難支，紛紛下山歸降，計斬首三千級、俘蠻民二萬三千餘人、降者二萬五千餘戶。降附與被俘之眾悉被遷往建康，編為營戶，交由軍府管轄；山中的原居寨落則被拆散空置，改由四處戍守控管，沔北山區自此歸入雍州版籍與荊北防線之中。對劉宋而言，這一場以兩萬餘人的遠征與數萬人的重新編籍換來了一州的實治、襄陽的據點與江漢上游的安寧，也換來了山地部族被拆散遷徙的結局。
resultEn: The result was a complete Song victory and a heavy defeat for the tribesmen. From the winter of 449 Shen Qingzhi led more than twenty thousand men into the mountains in eight columns, was checked first below Ruqiu hill, and then broke the stockades by cutting a path through the timber and climbing the heights on all eight columns together to the beating of drums; he then met the Great Yang attempt to fire the camps on a windy night with the pools already dug and with bows and crossbows firing in concert, driving them back into their heavy walls. Since the heights were steep and the paths hard, a direct assault was impossible, so garrisons were established at Donggang, Shushan, Yimin and Xichai to seal the mountain paths and cut the food route. Cut off and beset for long, the people on the hills could no longer hold out and came down to surrender, the account standing at three thousand beheaded, more than twenty-three thousand tribesmen taken prisoner and more than twenty-five thousand households come over. The prisoners and the surrendered were all removed to Jiankang and enrolled as garrison households under military jurisdiction; the old settlements in the hills were broken up and left empty, to be held instead by the four garrisons, and the country north of the Mian came under the register of Yongzhou and the northern Jing defence line. For Liu Song the exchange was a remote expedition of more than twenty thousand men and the re-registration of tens of thousands of people, bought with a province brought under real administration, a strongpoint at Xiangyang and quiet on the upper Han — and, on the other side of the ledger, a mountain people broken up and removed from their homes.
